# `exposed-to-origin-only`

**Tool rule** · `warning` · on by default

exposedTo entries are origins; a path, query, fragment or credentials in the entry is ignored by the API, so it does not narrow anything.

A tool rule judges one tool from its own definition, so it runs everywhere: `lint()`, `lintTools()`, the CLI, the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler and the ESLint plugin.

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "exposed-to-origin-only": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "exposed-to-origin-only": "warning" } }); // change severity
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule exposed-to-origin-only=off
```

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/exposed-to-origin-only": "error" } }
```
